snippet.description:
Are free UPSC courses on Telegram really enough to clear the UPSC exam?

In this discussion, Nikhil Sir, Santosh Sir and Karan Sir from LevelUp IAS break down the changing landscape of UPSC preparation and explain why content alone is not enough.

With lectures, notes and study material easily available online, aspirants often wonder whether they actually need a GS Foundation Course or can prepare entirely through free resources. The discussion explores the real trade-offs between time and money, and the importance of having a structured preparation system.

Enrol for GS Foundation Course 2028: https://www.levelupias.com/courses/upsc-cse-gs-foundation-course/
Apply for Rs. 50,000 Scholarship for GS Foundation 2028: https://www.levelupias.com/scholarship-test-for-upsc-gs-foundation/

The speakers discuss:

- Why free UPSC courses on Telegram can become a time-consuming trap
- The difference between collecting content and actually preparing
- Why a fixed schedule and discipline matter in UPSC preparation
- The role of guidance and mentorship
- Why a strong peer group and learning ecosystem can make a difference
- How classroom learning goes beyond just gaining knowledge
- Why UPSC preparation requires more than simply accessing lectures and study material

If you are preparing for UPSC CSE 2028, considering a GS Foundation Course, or wondering whether to prepare through free Telegram/YouTube resources, this discussion will help you think about what your preparation actually needs.

Watch the complete discussion to understand the real cost of free UPSC courses — not just in terms of money, but also time, discipline, guidance and preparation quality.
